//: Dev servers the Claude Code browser pane may start or attach to.
TRACKED, like .claude/settings.json and .claude/hooks — this is shared
configuration, not per-machine state. `.claude/skills/` is the only thing
under here that is ignored, and only the third-party half of it.
THE PREVIEWABLE SURFACES ONLY. scripts/dev-up.sh runs six services; three
of them are HTTP APIs (api 8080, admin-api 8090, mailer 8026) with nothing
to render, so they are absent — a preview pane pointed at a JSON health
check is noise. MAILPIT IS NOT ONE OF THOSE: the mailer service is an API,
but the Mailpit UI it delivers into is a real page on 8025, and it is where
you read what the app actually sent. It is listed for that reason.
`stack` IS THE ONE TO REACH FOR. scripts/dev-up.sh is a supervisor: it
brings up all six together and, when any one of them exits, brings the
rest down with it. That is a real trap — running an individual app's
dev-down.sh takes the WHOLE stack with it, which has already happened here.
So there is no per-app `runtimeExecutable` entry; every other configuration
ATTACHES (a `url` and no command) and can neither start nor stop anything.
`autoPort` IS FALSE, AND MUST STAY FALSE. The browser pane offers to move a
server to a free port when its own is taken; this one cannot move.
infra/envs/{dev,staging} register http://localhost:3000 as an EXACT-match
Cognito allowed origin — Cognito matches no wildcard host, path or port —
so a reassigned port does not degrade, it breaks sign-in outright. If 3000
is busy, free it (./scripts/dev-down.sh) rather than moving the server.
WHEN THE SPA SHELL CHANGES, RESTART. apps/insolvia_app/public/index.html
and app.config.ts are read once when the dev server starts, so an edit to
either is invisible until `stack` is restarted — a live-looking page that
silently predates the change. Metro hot-reloads src/, not these two.
